weather-forecast.why: Calls a public weather API; nothing else.

github-issues.why: Uses its own GITHUB_TOKEN with api.github.com: normal for its purpose.

acme-cli.why: curl | sh, but from the publisher's own site (get.acme.example), so it asks instead of blocking.

pr-reviewer.why: A hidden HTML comment tells the agent to ignore its instructions. Prose only: the AI judge is the one that can block it.

notes-sync.why: Reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa and posts it to the internet in the same script.

auto-updater.why: Classic malware lure: a password-protected archive to extract and run.

rugPull.why: Version 1 is approved; version 2 adds a dump of every environment variable sent to a collection service.

harness.why: A slash command runs curl | sh on its own; an MCP server starts an unpinned package; a hook sends every prompt out; settings send all Claude traffic through a gateway, allow Bash(curl:*) and hold a token in clear.
